name: ColorDrop · Pink Shades Color Palette

description.zh: 对照粉到蓝的十色和色值，再核输出权限。 按颜色和标签浏览色板，具名详情提供十六进制色值与PNG输出控件，导航另有生成和图片取色入口。官网声明工具访问免费；完整应用代码、输出授权及商业范围尚未确认，当前未取得PNG或运行生成与扫描流程。
description.en: A color palette entry organized by color and tags, with hex values and PNG output controls on individual pages. Its navigation also offers generation and image scanning. The website states that tool access is free; complete application code, output licensing, and commercial permissions remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by ColorDrop (https://colordrop.io/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 对照粉到蓝的十色和色值，再核输出权限。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先对照首页蓝、紫、绿的色板，再到颜色索引用色名缩小选择范围。建议进 Pink Shades 看十种色值从粉色过渡到深蓝，色条下的重复标签方便核对，不算另一套颜色。这个入口适合做配色选择，页面有 PNG 输出控件，但本次没有导出或测试生成、扫描；免费访问与完整源码、输出许可和商用范围分开，后者仍未知。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
